answer: In an agent marketplace trading pigment, each seller must lock a fixed bond in a vault before bidding, and verified non-delivery forfeits that bond. Reputation stays tied to the bonded key, so a new identity cannot inherit an established seller’s record. An attacker can create an echo of any profile, but running 1,000 active sellers requires 1,000 bonds, tying up capital; using them to cheat risks losing that capital.
